title: Accounts
subtitle: Connect the networks you publish to.
demoToken: Demo: nothing is sent to {network}. Any details connect a sample account; a secret containing "invalid" is rejected so you can see the error.
demoOauth: Demo: the real {network} sign-in is skipped; Connect adds a sample account.
noneYet: No account connected yet. Connect one below, then <link>write your first post</link>.
orphans: {count, plural, one {# account belongs to a network that is no longer available.} other {# accounts belong to a network that is no longer available.}}
disconnectBody: Posts scheduled for {account} fail unless you connect it again before they are due. Published posts stay on {network}.
disconnectBodyUnnamed: Posts scheduled for this account fail unless you connect it again before they are due. Published posts stay on {network}.

caps.label: Capabilities
caps.supports: {capability, select, text {Supports text posts} image {Supports image posts} video {Supports video posts} schedule {Supports scheduling by the network} delete {Supports deleting published posts} analytics {Supports analytics} other {Supported}}
caps.lacks: {capability, select, text {Does not support text posts} image {Does not support image posts} video {Does not support video posts} schedule {Does not support scheduling by the network} delete {Does not support deleting published posts} analytics {Does not support analytics} other {Not supported}}

tokenConnect.noteHttps: Steerpost receives these details over HTTPS, stores them encrypted and never shows them again.
tokenConnect.noteHttp: Steerpost stores these details encrypted and never shows them again.
tokenConnect.httpsUrl: {field} must be an https address, for example https://example.com.
tokenConnect.outOfDate: This form is out of date. Reload the page and try again.
tokenConnect.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
tokenConnect.noScope: This sign-in is not allowed to connect accounts. Use a key with the social:connect permission.
tokenConnect.forbidden: You do not have permission to connect accounts.
tokenConnect.rejected: {network} did not accept these details. Check them with “How to connect {network}” and try again. Nothing was saved.
tokenConnect.unreachable: {network} could not be reached to check these details. Try again in a moment.

telegram.connectBody: You prove you control it by posting a one-time code there, so only chats you own can be connected.
telegram.expired: This code has expired. Codes work for 15 minutes and only once.

telegram.retrying: Having trouble reaching the server. Retrying…
